title: Slovakian-Mexican Pork Casserole
description: A twist on traditional Slovakian pork dishes, this casserole combines oven-roasted pork with the bold flavors of Mexican cuisine.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with Mexican Spice Blend.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork to a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the Slovakian sausage and cook until browned, breaking up with a spoon as needed.
Stir in the oven-roasted tomatoes and Mexican Cheese Blend.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Stir in chopped cilantro and serve hot.
